text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, Jan 28 - Chittagong - 20 Vessels in port of which 4 containers, 5 general cargo, one 48 hours, 1 foodgrain, 2 tankers, 1 seed, 1 other vessel, 2 cement, 3 fertiliser. 30 Vessels due by 4/2 of which 10 containers, 2 general cargo, 2 export loaders, two 48 hours, 4 tankers, 1 seed, 2 others, 1 cement, 3 fertiliser, 1 survey, 1 cement clinker, 1 scrap. 7-8 Days berthing delay for general cargo vessels.

INDIA, 28 Jan - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 1-2 days, bulk vessels 12-15 days, general cargo vessels 2-3 days. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 19 discharging at berth, 7 waiting at anchorage to load, 21 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 1 Vessel bunkering, 1 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Calcutta - 15 Vessels due of which 2 coking coal, 6 product tankers, 1 coke, 5 containers, 1 lead concentrate. 5 Vessels loading at berth, 20 discharging at berth, 1 bunkering. Cochin - Seven vessels due, up to 1 days delay expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 5 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 oil tanker in dry-dock, 1

Delays expected, coal/coke 4 days, fertiliser 2-3 days, scrap 4-5 days, others 2-3 days, no delays for containers, iron ore. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 10 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 vessel in dry-dock under repair. Kandla - 15 Vessels due, 4-5 days delay expected, 5 vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 8 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 vessels bunkering at jetty, 13 vessels waiting. Mangalore - 12 Vessels due, 2-3 days delay expected, 4 vessels loading,discharging at berth, 2 vessels awaiting berth. Jawahlal Nehru - One vessel due (fertiliser,raw material), 8-10 days berthing delay expected. 3 Vessels due (tankers/iron ore), 2-3 days berthing delay expected. 2 Vessels discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load (tanker/iron ore), 1 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (fertiliser/raw material).

Paradip - Vessels due, 2 coal, 2 chrome, 1 fertiliser, 1 oil, 1 chemical,gas, up to 1 days delay expected for coal. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Tuticorin - Four vessels due, 1-2 days delay expected, 6 vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load. MALAYSIA, Jan 29 - Port Kelang - North/south port - Container/ro-ro berth - 6 Vessels alongside, 2 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels alongside, 2 berthed, 4 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, 6 waiting, 4 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 4 Vessels alongside, 2 waiting, 3 days waiting time. West port - Container/ro-ro berth - 2 Vessels alongside. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels alongside, 6 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Bulk cement terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, 3 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 1 Vessel alongside, no waiting time.

MAURITIUS, Jan 28 - Port Louis - Two container vessels discharging and loading, 2 general cargo vessels discharging, 1 vessel discharging rice into lighters (at buoys berth). Fishing port busy with 6 vessels discharging/loading, no idle vessels, 1 vessel in drydock.
PAKISTAN, Jan 27 - Karachi - Four vessels due. Delays

expected, 3-4 days for general cargo, 2 days for container vessels, 4 vessels loading at berth (rice, general cargo), 4 container vessels loading and discharging at berth. 11 Vessels discharging at berth (general cargo, urea, dap, phosphate, sugar, hsd, fuel oil). 4 Rice vessels waiting at anchorage to load. 18 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (general cargo, containers, fertiliser, oil tankers, sugar, hsd). 3 Vessels awaiting orders, 1 awaiting crew change. SIERRA LEONE, Jan 27, Freetown - Vessels due, 1 wheat discharger, 2 container dischargers, 1 oil discharger, 1 container/vehicles discharger, 1 bauxite loader, no delays expected. 1 Vessel discharging/loading sugar at berth, 1 cargo vessel anchored. Vessels must be in/out of port before 1900 hours.

SINGAPORE, Jan 28 - Singapore - Ttanjong Pagar container terminal - 9 Container vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 12 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang - 6 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang - 1 General cargo vessel berthed. Jurong - 1 Bulk cargo, steel, general cargo vessel berthed. Oil terminal - 27 Tankers berthed. Minimum berthing delays all facilities.

SRI LANKA, Jan 28 - Colombo - Vessels due, 8 containers, 1 onions, 1 bagged rice, 1 vehicle, 1 bulk cement. 2 Days delay for conventional vessels. 10 Vessels loading at berth of which 4 essential services, 6 containers. Discharging at berth, 1 bagged sugar, 8 containers, 1 bulk lpg, 1 bulk maize, 1 bagged flour, 3 general cargo. Waiting at anchorage to discharge, 3 bagged rice, 1 bagged fertiliser. 2 Vessels bunkering, 2 in drydock, 7 awaiting orders. Galle - One vessel loading at berth. Trincomalee - Two vessels discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth.

SOUTH KOREA, Jan 28 - Inchon - 74 Vessels in port (45 berthed, 29 anchored) of which 10 general cargo, 5 logs, 4 steel, 3 each coils, scrap, 2 each plywood, pig iron, salt, cars, corn, 1 each steel plates, sesame, soybean, h-beam, alfalfa, bananas, containers, glass, wheat, raw sugar. Anchored, 5 cars, 4 general cargo, 3 containers, 2 each wheat, scrap, coils, steel, logs, pig iron, corn, 1 each talc, pulp, cotton seed meal, approx. 1-2 days berthing delay expect. Busan - 168 Vessels in port (48 berthed, 120 anchored including 60 laid up) of which 34 general cargo, 6 containers, 5 scrap, 3 coal. 60 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 2 days delay expected.

Pohang - 24 Vessels in port (23 berthed, 1 anchored) of which discharging, 5 coils, 2 each coal, billets, 1 each iron ore, cokes, pig iron, h-beam, hot briquette iron, scrap. 8 Vessels loading steel, 1 vessel awaiting berth with approx. 1 days delay expected. Ulsan - 20 Vessels in port (18 berthed, 2 anchored) of which discharging, 3 chemicals, 2 woodchips, 1 each coal, ammonia, feed meal, styrene monomer, fertiliser, sugar, corn. Loading, 5 resin, 1 steel pipes. 2 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 1-2 days delays expected. Masan - Seven vessels berthed of which discharging, 2 steel scrap, 1 each steel slabs, bananas, talc powder. Loading, 1 cigar, 1 container. No berthing delays

TAIWAN, Jan 25 - Keelung - Four vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 4 days, coal 7 days, steel 4 days, iron ore 3 days. Kaohsiung - Four vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 2 days, iron,coal, (csc berth) 3 days, coal,scrap (public berth) 2 days, steel 1 day. Taichung - Five vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 2-3 days, iron ore, coal, scrap, steel and others 1 day. Jan 27 - Keelung - Vessels in port, 11 containers, 1 tanker, 8 other bulkers, 5 general. Vessels waiting at outer anchorage, 4 containers, 1 tanker. Berthing delays, 10 hours for containers, 1 day for tankers.
